title: Sun shadow blockers made shadow-only in 20 MP/coop paks (London Underground library lighting) + Fort stairs / plaster panel materials (map-lighting/apply_map_lighting.py)
notes: By 33martyr (PR #3). Blockers (material shadowblocker / ik-only / canopy-shadow) get +0x20 |= 0x10000 and +0x24 |= 0x101, the retail hidden-blocker rule; without it the sun floods interiors (London library: bright floor, dark walls, hard shafts). Fort: stone-steps layer swap + PS3 spec terms, plaster-cream border tint, template metalness removed. Recipe 1.12.0 kept London and Fort only (the other paks restored from backup-map-lighting); 1.13.0 applies it to every pak again (KEEP = None, nothing restored). Some maps may still look off (user check 2026-11-09). In place, no size change, idempotent.
